description: Defines a sealed class that models different synchronization statuses for a note organizer app, including states like Idle, Running, Success with timestamp, and Error with message.

classes.name: SyncStatus
classes.description: Sealed class representing various synchronization states for UI and diagnostics, with concrete object and data class implementations.

methods.name: Idle
methods.description: Object representing the idle sync state.

methods.name: Running
methods.description: Object representing the ongoing sync state.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Data class indicating a successful sync, includes timestamp when the sync finished.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Data class indicating a sync error, contains an error message.
